admissible_source_evidence.variant_a:
Group board visibility

Setting: show my practice streak on the group board.
Chosen by: the member, today.
Visible to: members of the evening practice group.
Lasts: until the end of the current season, then switches off by itself.
The member can switch it off sooner in Settings.
admissible_source_evidence.variant_b: You're on the board! From today, the members of your evening practice group can see your practice streak on the group board - you switched this on yourself just now. It stays on for the next twelve weeks and then turns itself off, so you never need to remember to undo it. Changed your mind before then? Just switch it off in Settings.
